subject: Press citation rights & badge placement for upcoming Acme release
messages:
From: Sandra Patel <sandra.patel@acmetx.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jorge Ramos <jorge.ramos@acmetx.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to cite Redwood in upcoming press release

Hi Vanessa,

Hope youre well. Were finalizing a short press announcement for Acmes new inference pipeline and would like to include a short quote about our experience with Redwood. The sentence were planning to use is: "Redwood Inference helped us reduce inference costs by ~40% while maintaining response quality."

Two quick asks:
- Can Redwood confirm we have permission to use that quote in a press release?
- Wed also like to add a small Redwood badge/logo on the assets (PDF + press page). Are there any placement or attribution rules we need to follow?

Timeline: aiming to publish week of July 19, so a sign-off by EOD July 16 would be ideal. I can share mockups if that helps.

Thanks much,
Sandra
Sandra Patel
Head of Corporate Comms, Acme Therapeutics
attachments: (none)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sandra Patel <sandra.patel@acmetx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to cite Redwood in upcoming press release

Hi Sandra — thanks for the note and congrats on the launch.

On Mon, Jul 12, 2026 at 9:12 AM Sandra Patel <sandra.patel@acmetx.com> wrote:
> Hope youre well. Were finalizing a short press announcement for Acmes new inference pipeline and would like to include a short quote about our experience with Redwood.
>

Ive looped in Marissa (PR/Comms) and Laura (Brand) for logo/badge guidance and Aditya for a quick contractual check. Marissa — can you share the brand placement rules and the downloadable logo pack?

Sandra, if you can attach the mockup (PDF/png) that shows where youd like the badge, that will speed sign-off. Were generally fine with short customer quotes for press; Marissa will outline the small usage policy.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference
attachments: (none)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sandra Patel <sandra.patel@acmetx.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-13T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to cite Redwood in upcoming press release — brand guidelines and assets attached

Hi Sandra (and team),

Thanks for the heads-up — happy to help. See attached: brand-badge-guidelines.pdf and redwood_logo_pack.zip (svg/png/pdf). Key points: 

- Approved usage: short customer quotes are permitted for press and marketing assets with explicit permission.
- Badge placement: we prefer the badge to appear in the document footer or a sponsor/logo row; top-right placement is acceptable only on one-sheet companion PDFs, not the headline web banner.
- Clearspace: 12px minimum around the badge at the sizes youre proposing; do not compress or recolor the mark beyond the mono option in the pack.
- Attribution: include the following line on the press page or in the caption: "Redwood Inference (used with permission)." Please do not imply product endorsement beyond the quoted statement.

If youd like, we can approve the final mockup once you upload it to the Drive link below or send here as a PDF. Assuming placement follows the guidance above, we aim to provide sign-off within 24–48 hours.

Drive (brand assets): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood-BrandAssets

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketing Communications, Redwood Inference
attachments: brand-badge-guidelines.pdf, redwood_logo_pack.zip

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-13T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to cite Redwood in upcoming press release — quick legal check

Vanessa / Marissa — quick sign-off from my side with a minor tweak.

Approved: use of the quote and badge as outlined by Marissa with the following conditions:
- The quote text is acceptable as-is, but please ensure its attributed to Acme Therapeutics (company name + title optional).
- Add a short parenthetical or footnote linking to the public case study or press kit URL when possible; this helps with provenance.
- Do not use the badge in a way that suggests Redwood endorses any unannounced Acme features.

Once Marissa confirms placement and Sandra shares the mockup, this can be considered final approval.

Aditya Rao
Sales Operations (legal liaison), Redwood Inference
attachments: (none)

From: Sandra Patel <sandra.patel@acmetx.com>

Cc: Jorge Ramos <jorge.ramos@acmetx.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to cite Redwood in upcoming press release — mockup attached

Thanks all — attaching the mockup (acme_press_mockup.pdf). We placed the Redwood badge in the lower-right corner of the PDF and included the quote with attribution to "Acme Therapeutics, Head of Infrastructure".

Per Marissas guidance, we kept the badge in the footer on the one-sheet and added the attribution line on the press page. Please let me know if the placement is acceptable or if we should move it to the footer center.

Requested sign-off timeframe: EOD Friday July 16 so we can send to publications the following week.

Thanks for the quick turn — appreciate it.
Sandra
attachments: acme_press_mockup.pdf
